sources.title: CircuitFormer: A Circuit Language Model for Analog Topology Design from ...
sources.snippet: Accordingly, circuits should be treated as a distinct modality within multimodal learning, analogous to images or video. CircuitFormer operationalizes this view by decoupling topological representation from textual serialization, enabling translation from high-level natural language intent to physically valid, graph-structured circuit designs.

sources.title: CircuitFormer: A Circuit Language Model for Analog Topology Design from ...
sources.snippet: Summary This paper introduces CircuitFormer, a circuit-specific language model for automated analog circuit design from natural language prompts, addressing the limitations of applying general-purpose LLMs to hardware design by curating a large dataset and proposing a novel circuit graph tokenizer.
